rationale: The breakout thesis has failed: price never sustained above today's high of $54.25, has fallen back below the 9-EMA ($53.81), and the most recent candle tagged the original invalidation level of $53.60 at its low before closing at $53.79 — a clear sign that the intraday buyers who drove the entry setup have lost control. With the maximum favorable excursion a mere 0.17% against a maximum adverse excursion of -0.51%, reward/risk has inverted and there is no mechanical basis to continue holding the position.
